scripts.build: corepack pnpm --dir ../sdk exec tsup ../indexer/src/server.ts --format esm --platform node --target node22 --out-dir ../indexer/dist --clean --splitting false && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='dist/server.js';fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace(/from \"sqlite\"/g,'from \"node:sqlite\"'));"
